parameters.query:
WITH target_values AS (
    -- 1. Split the n8n comma-separated text list into individual rows
    SELECT trim(unnest(string_to_array('{{ $json.vals }}', ','))) AS val
),
available_docs AS (
    -- 2. Find matching documents and EXCLUDE the negative list
    SELECT 
        d.id,
        d.doc_name,
        d.metadata,
        tv.val AS matched_category
    FROM documents d
    -- FIX: Pointing directly to the column instead of inside the metadata JSON
    JOIN target_values tv ON d."{{ $json.key }}" = tv.val
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM categories c 
        WHERE c.category_name = '{{ $json.key }}' 
          -- The Anti-Join: Excludes docs already in the negative list
          AND d.doc_name = ANY(COALESCE(c.saturation_docs, ARRAY[]::text[]))
    )
),
ranked_docs AS (
    -- 3. Group and assign a random number
    SELECT 
        id, doc_name, metadata, matched_category,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY matched_category 
            ORDER BY RANDOM()
        ) as rn
    FROM available_docs
)
-- 4. Grab exactly 1 random document per category
SELECT id, doc_name, metadata, matched_category
FROM ranked_docs
WHERE rn = 1;
